spiritgiven.comments: Great game! We talked about the contact at half and great job improving it!

Thankyou Netherlands for the game! The 1’s explanations
Fouls and Body Contact: When the first dangerous play was called we told you guys to be a little more aware of your space, but 3 more dangerous plays happened after that. 
Fair-Mindedness: We felt that you guys had a strong predisposition that you were right and that we didn’t know the rules. At the same,  there were many instances in which you guys didn’t do the hand signals on a call and then exclaimed that we didn’t fix the stuff.

Tough game Hungary! Explanations, Rules: Multiple instances in which we had to explain basic rules like violations and infractions. Fair: Many exclaimed reactions when we made calls. Almost always there was a fight in the calls. Attitude: Even though it was mostly one player, the repetition of it is what makes it a 0. The decision to not take him out of the field or even talk to him is a team decision. At the end many players were also very disrespectful. Com: No hand signals.
Thankyou Hong Kong!! Great match, it was so fun playing with you!!

Great game, Thankyou!! Explanations Fair-mindedness: We felt there where more than a few calls in which you were only making them to benefit your game. Communication: Your players don’t know the hand signals, several times they made the wrong signals during calls and discussions. Still thankyou for the game.

Thank you Hong Kong! there were many fouls called on minor contacts by our team that didn’t affect play, very often stopping the game unnecessarily. We felt those same calls made on minor contact were made mostly when you were out of options and needed a break rather than in a consistent manner.

Once again thank you for the games! We hope to play you again.

spiritreceived.comments: As we have discussed in the spirit circle we both thought it wasn’t a very good game. We hope that we see u again and than have a better game. Greetings and goodluck Dutch Mixed
Calls were resolved quickly, and the communication was pretty good.
It was a really good spirit since the game. Even if the score was hard, they never gave up and they smiled during all the game. Good luck for next games !

1. This was regarding a defensive play followed by a "ground strip". Rule 13.5.1 - please review the rulebook especially regarding intercepting a disc on defence but dropping it accidentally or losing control of the disc due to ground contact (rule 13.5.1). If this occurs, any player on offence can take possession of the disc".

2. A lot of minor contact when defending our handlers plus when on offense there were certain instances of shoving and pushing.

Overall really positively competitive game and great spirit & support on the sidelines. Good luck in the rest of the tournament.

There weren’t any huge issues just small ones that were repetitive, their coaches seemed to be yelling from the sidelines mad everytime a call was made yelling stuff like “that was so clean, play on”. Had a lot of disputes over rules, such as the offside rule and contact rule on marks.

Panama, Thanks for this game, we saw some improvement from the last game but we still had some comments. For fouls and body contact, we saw improvement from the last game with less dangerous plays but on the F-matching players it was to much for us and also there was one very dangerous play that injured on of us. On fair-mindedness we thought your sideline was talking to much, as we said in the spirit circle. We do want to thank you very much and wish you good luck with your last games Ned x

2. First half there were several instances of pushing and shoving as plus marking  infractions such as double-teams. The second half was a big improvement. Thank u for listening and understanding.
4. Great attitude on the sidelines!! Unfortunately there were a few reports of players being unspirited, but overall as a team ur attitude is great!!
5. Communication was pretty smooth throughout, however there were instances where ur player didn't listen or consider the other perspective. Thank you!!
